verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the agent architecture lets you pick a 'TTS model' per language (deepgram-docs-10), but unlike the explicit multi-vendor LLM provider list (open_ai, anthropic, aws_bedrock, google, groq, nvidia), there is no equivalent list of supported third-party TTS providers or a documented voice catalog/library for the Voice Agent. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of pluggable TTS providers (e.g. ElevenLabs, Azure, etc.) within the Agent API, and documentation of a broad selectable voice library.
